$comment: Configuration defaults every SDK applies (contract 02 §3). Durations are in seconds here; the JS SDK takes milliseconds at its API surface and converts. Resolution order for a setting is always: the argument, then the environment variable, then the deprecated environment variable (with a warning naming its replacement), then the default below.
base_url_rule: https:// is required. Plain http:// is accepted only when the host is one of plain_http_hosts.
api_key_split: Split with a bounded split("_", 3): the secret contains '_'.

backoff.formula: uniform(0, min(cap_seconds, initial_seconds * 2^(n-1))) before attempt n
